# t.snapshot(name) captures Model.View() output and diffs against a
# golden under app.sngl.snapshots/initial.ansi.


# First run with SNGL_UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=1 creates the golden.
env SNGL_UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=1
sngl test --platform=bubbletea app.sngl
stdout 'PASS'
exists app.sngl.snapshots/initial.ansi

# Second run without the env var passes against the same golden.
env SNGL_UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=
sngl test --platform=bubbletea app.sngl
stdout 'PASS'

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

output { go { bubbletea } }

component counter node {
    var count = 0
    text(value=string(count))
}

func testInitialSnapshotMatches(t Test, c counter) {
    t.snapshot("initial")
}

window {
}
-- testrun/bubbletea/go/app.sngl/counter/1 --

  "results": [
    {
      "Desc": "InitialSnapshotMatches",
      "Passed": true
    }
  ],
  "snapshots": {
    "initial.ansi": "MA=="
  }
}
